Comments.title: Comments
Comments.empty: No comments yet. Start the discussion.
Comments.composerPlaceholder: Comment — @ to mention, # to reference a record
Comments.deleteBody: The comment is removed for everyone and can't be restored. Its place in the thread is kept.
Comments.conflict: This thread changed elsewhere — refreshed, try again
Comments.deepLinkGone: That comment isn't available here anymore — it may have been removed or its record changed.
